arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
transliteration: Iqtaraba linnaasi hisaa buhum wa hum fee ghaflatim mu'ridoon

translations.en.sahih: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
translations.en.pickthall: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness.
translations.en.yusufali: Closer and closer to mankind comes their Reckoning: yet they heed not and they turn away.
translations.id.indonesian: Telah dekat kepada manusia hari menghisab segala amalan mereka, sedang mereka berada dalam kelalaian lagi berpaling (daripadanya).

arabic: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
transliteration: Maa yaateehim min zikrim mir Rabbihim muhdasin illas tama'oohu wa hum yal'aboon

translations.en.sahih: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
translations.en.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,
translations.en.yusufali: Never comes (aught) to them of a renewed Message from their Lord, but they listen to it as in jest,-
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak datang kepada mereka suatu ayat Al Quran pun yang baru (di-turunkan) dari Tuhan mereka, melainkan mereka mendengarnya, sedang mereka bermain-main,

arabic: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Laahiyatan quloobuhum; wa asarrun najwal lazeena zalamoo hal haazaa illaa basharum mislukum afataa toonas sihra wa antum tubsiroon

translations.en.sahih: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
translations.en.pickthall: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?
translations.en.yusufali: Their hearts toying as with trifles. The wrong-doers conceal their private counsels, (saying), "Is this (one) more than a man like yourselves? Will ye go to witchcraft with your eyes open?"
translations.id.indonesian: (lagi) hati mereka dalam keadaan lalai. Dan mereka yang zalim itu merahasiakan pembicaraan mereka: "Orang ini tidak lain hanyalah seorang manusia (jua) seperti kamu, maka apakah kamu menerima sihir itu, padahal kamu menyaksikannya?"

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbee ya'lamul qawla fis samaaa'i wal ardi wa Huwas Samee'ul Aleem

translations.en.sahih: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
translations.en.pickthall: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "My Lord knoweth (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth: He is the One that heareth and knoweth (all things)."
translations.id.indonesian: Berkatalah Muhammad (kepada mereka): "Tuhanku mengetahui semua perkataan di langit dan di bumi dan Dialah Yang Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Mengetahui".

arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
transliteration: Bal qaalooo adghaasu ahlaamim balif taraahu bal huwa shaa'irun falyaatinaa bi Aayatin kamaa ursilal awwaloon

translations.en.sahih: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).
translations.en.yusufali: "Nay," they say, "(these are) medleys of dream! - Nay, He forged it! - Nay, He is (but) a poet! Let him then bring us a Sign like the ones that were sent to (Prophets) of old!"
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan mereka berkata (pula): "(Al Quran itu adalah) mimpi-mimpi yang kalut, malah diada-adakannya, bahkan dia sendiri seorang penyair, maka hendaknya ia mendatangkan kepada kita suatu mukjizat, sebagai-mana rasul-rasul yang telah lalu di-utus".

arabic: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Maaa aaamanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa a-fahum yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
translations.en.pickthall: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe?
translations.en.yusufali: (As to those) before them, not one of the populations which We destroyed believed: will these believe?
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada (penduduk) suatu negeripun yang beriman yang Kami telah membinasakannya sebeIum mereka; maka apakah mereka akan beriman?

arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Wa maaa arsalnaa qablaka illaa rijaalan nooheee ilaihim fas'aloo ahlaz zikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
translations.en.pickthall: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not?
translations.en.yusufali: Before thee, also, the messengers We sent were but men, to whom We granted inspiration: If ye realise this not, ask of those who possess the Message.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami tiada mengutus rasul rasul sebelum kamu (Muhammad), melainkan beberapa orang-laki-laki yang Kami beri wahyu kepada mereka, maka tanyakanlah olehmu kepada orang-orang yang berilmu, jika kamu tiada mengetahui.

arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa ja'alnaahum jasadal laa yaakuloonat ta'aama wa maa kaanoo khaalideen

translations.en.sahih: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
translations.en.pickthall: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor did We give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they exempt from death.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidaklah Kami jadikan mereka tubuh-tubuh yang tiada memakan makanan, dan tidak (pula) mereka itu orang-orang yang kekal.

arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
transliteration: summa sadaqnaa humul wa'da fa-anjainaahum wa man nashaaa'u wa ahlaknal musrifeen

translations.en.sahih: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
translations.en.pickthall: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals.
translations.en.yusufali: In the end We fulfilled to them Our Promise, and We saved them and those whom We pleased, but We destroyed those who transgressed beyond bounds.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami tepati janji (yang telah Kami janjikan) kepada mereka. Maka Kami selamatkan mereka dan orang-orang yang Kami kehendaki dan Kami binasakan orang-orang yang melampaui batas.

arabic: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
transliteration: Laqad anzalnaaa ilaikum Kitaaban feehi zikrukum afalaa ta'qiloon

translations.en.sahih: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
translations.en.pickthall: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense?
translations.en.yusufali: We have revealed for you (O men!) a book in which is a Message for you: will ye not then understand?
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya telah Kami turunkan kepada kamu sebuah kitab yang di dalamnya terdapat sebab-sebab kemuliaan bagimu. Maka apakah kamu tiada memahaminya?

arabic: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
transliteration: Wa kam qasamnaa min qaryatin kannat zaalimatanw wa anshadnaa ba'dahaa qawman aakhareen

translations.en.sahih: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
translations.en.pickthall: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk!
translations.en.yusufali: How many were the populations We utterly destroyed because of their iniquities, setting up in their places other peoples?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berapa banyaknya (penduduk) negeri yang zalim yang teIah Kami binasakan, dan Kami adakan sesudah mereka itu kaum yang lain (sebagai penggantinya).

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
transliteration: Falammaaa ahassoo baasanaaa izaaa hum minhaa yarkudoon

translations.en.sahih: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
translations.en.pickthall: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it!
translations.en.yusufali: Yet, when they felt Our Punishment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tatkala mereka merasakan azab Kami, tiba-tiba mereka melarikan diri dari negerinya.

arabic: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
transliteration: Laa tarkudoo warji'ooo ilaa maaa utriftum feehe wa masaakinikum la'allakum tus'aloon

translations.en.sahih: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
translations.en.pickthall: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned.
translations.en.yusufali: Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account.
translations.id.indonesian: Janganlah kamu lari tergesa-gesa; kembalilah kamu kepada nikmat yang telah kamu rasakan dan kepada tempat-tempat kediamanmu (yang baik), supaya kamu ditanya.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo yaa wailanaaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
translations.en.pickthall: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Ah! woe to us! We were indeed wrong-doers!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Aduhai, celaka kami, sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang zaIim".

arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ
transliteration: Famaa zaalat tilka da'waahum hattaa ja'alnaahum haseedan khaamideen

translations.en.sahih: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
translations.en.pickthall: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.
translations.en.yusufali: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is mown, as ashes silent and quenched.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tetaplah demikian keluhan mereka, sehingga Kami jadikan mereka sebagai tanaman yang telah dituai, yang tidak dapat hidup lagi.

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa khalaqnas samaaa'a wal arda wa maa bainahumaa laa'ibeen

translations.en.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
translations.en.pickthall: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play.
translations.en.yusufali: Not for (idle) sport did We create the heavens and the earth and all that is between!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidaklah Kami ciptakan Iangit dan bumi dan segala yang ada di antara keduanya dengan bermain-main.

arabic: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
transliteration: Law aradnaaa an nattakhiza lahwal lat takhaznaahu mil ladunnaaa in kunnaa faa'ileen

translations.en.sahih: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
translations.en.pickthall: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did.
translations.en.yusufali: If it had been Our wish to take (just) a pastime, We should surely have taken it from the things nearest to Us, if We would do (such a thing)!
translations.id.indonesian: Sekiranya Kami hendak membuat sesuatu permainan, (isteri dan anak), tentulah Kami membuatnya dari sisi Kami. Jika Kami menghendaki berbuat demikian, (tentulah Kami telah melakukannya).

arabic: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
transliteration: Bal naqzifu bilhaqqi 'alal baatili fa yadmaghuhoo fa izaa huwa zaahiq; wa lakumul wailu mimmaa tasifoon

translations.en.sahih: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, We hurl the Truth against falsehood, and it knocks out its brain, and behold, falsehood doth perish! Ah! woe be to you for the (false) things ye ascribe (to Us).
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarya Kami melontarkan yang hak kepada yang batil lalu yang hak itu menghancurkannya, maka dengan serta merta yang batil itu lenyap. Dan kecelakaanlah bagimu disebabkan kamu mensifati (Allah dengan sifat-sifat yang tidak layak bagi-Nya).

arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa lahoo man fis samaawaati wal ard; wa man 'indahoo laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaada tihee wa laa yastahsiroon

translations.en.sahih: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary;
translations.en.yusufali: To Him belong all (creatures) in the heavens and on earth: Even those who are in His (very) Presence are not too proud to serve Him, nor are they (ever) weary (of His service):
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kepunyaan-Nya-lah segala yang di langit dan di bumi. Dan malaikat-malaikat yang di sisi-Nya, mereka tiada mempunyai rasa angkuh untuk menyembah-Nya dan tiada (pula) merasa letih.

arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
transliteration: Yusabbihoona laila wannahaara laa yafturoon

translations.en.sahih: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
translations.en.pickthall: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not.
translations.en.yusufali: They celebrate His praises night and day, nor do they ever flag or intermit.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka selalu bertasbih malam dan siang tiada henti-hentinya.

arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
transliteration: Amit takhazooo aalihatam minal ardi hum yunshiroon

translations.en.sahih: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
translations.en.pickthall: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead?
translations.en.yusufali: Or have they taken (for worship) gods from the earth who can raise (the dead)?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka mengambil tuhan-tuhan dari bumi, yang dapat menghidupkan (orang-orang mati)?

arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
transliteration: Law kaana feehimaaa aalihatun illal laahu lafasadataa; fa-Subhaanal laahi Rabbil 'Arshi 'ammaa yasifoon

translations.en.sahih: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
translations.en.pickthall: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him).
translations.en.yusufali: If there were, in the heavens and the earth, other gods besides Allah, there would have been confusion in both! but glory to Allah, the Lord of the Throne: (High is He) above what they attribute to Him!
translations.id.indonesian: Sekiranya ada di langit dan di bumi tuhan-tuhan selain Allah, tentulah keduanya itu telah rusak binasa. Maka Maha Suci Allah yang mempunyai 'Arsy daripada apa yang mereka sifatkan.

arabic: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
transliteration: Laa yus'alu 'ammaa yaf'alu wa hum yus'aloon

translations.en.sahih: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
translations.en.pickthall: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.
translations.en.yusufali: He cannot be questioned for His acts, but they will be questioned (for theirs).
translations.id.indonesian: Dia tidak ditanya tentang apa yang diperbuat-Nya dan merekalah yang akan ditanyai.

arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
transliteration: Amit takhazoo min doonihee aalihatan qul haatoo burhaanakum haaza zikru mam ma'iya wa zikru man qablee; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoonal haqqa fahum mu'ridoon

translations.en.sahih: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
translations.en.pickthall: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse.
translations.en.yusufali: Or have they taken for worship (other) gods besides him? Say, "Bring your convincing proof: this is the Message of those with me and the Message of those before me." But most of them know not the Truth, and so turn away.
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka mengambil tuhan-tuhan selain-Nya? Katakanlah: "Unjukkanlah hujjahmu! (Al Quran) ini adalah peringatan bagi orang-orang yang bersamaku, dan peringatan bagi orang-orang yang sebelumku". Sebenarnya kebanyakan mereka tiada mengetahui yang hak, karena itu mereka berpaling.

arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
transliteration: Wa maaa arsalnaa min qablika mir Rasoolin illaa nooheee ilaihi annahoo laaa ilaaha illaaa Ana fa'budoon

translations.en.sahih: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
translations.en.pickthall: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me.
translations.en.yusufali: Not a messenger did We send before thee without this inspiration sent by Us to him: that there is no god but I; therefore worship and serve Me.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tidak mengutus seorang rasulpun sebelum kamu melainkan Kami wahyukan kepadanya: "Bahwasanya tidak ada Tuhan (yang hak) melainkan Aku, maka sembahlah olehmu sekalian akan Aku".

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
transliteration: Wa qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladan Subhaanah; bal 'ibaadum mkkramoon

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves;
translations.en.yusufali: And they say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten offspring." Glory to Him! they are (but) servants raised to honour.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah telah mengambil (mempunyai) anak", Maha Suci Allah. Sebenarnya (malaikat-malaikat itu), adalah hamba-hamba yang dimuliakan,

arabic: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Laa yasbiqoonahoo bil qawli wa hum bi amrihee ya'maloon

translations.en.sahih: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
translations.en.pickthall: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command.
translations.en.yusufali: They speak not before He speaks, and they act (in all things) by His Command.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka itu tidak mendahului-Nya dengan perkataan dan mereka mengerjakan perintah-perintah-Nya.

arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
transliteration: Ya'lamu maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yashfa'oona illaa limanir tadaa wa hum min khash yatihee mushfiqoon

translations.en.sahih: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
translations.en.pickthall: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him.
translations.en.yusufali: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they offer no intercession except for those who are acceptable, and they stand in awe and reverence of His (Glory).
translations.id.indonesian: Allah mengetahui segala sesuatu yang dihadapan mereka (malaikat) dan yang di belakang mereka, dan mereka tiada memberi syafa'at melainkan kepada orang yang diridhai Allah, dan mereka itu selalu berhati-hati karena takut kepada-Nya.

arabic: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa mai yaqul minhum inneee ilaahum min doonihee fazaalika najzeehi Jahannam; kazaalika najziz zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
translations.en.pickthall: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers.
translations.en.yusufali: If any of them should say, "I am a god besides Him", such a one We should reward with Hell: thus do We reward those who do wrong.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan barangsiapa di antara mereka, mengatakan: "Sesungguhnya Aku adalah tuhan selain daripada Allah", maka orang itu Kami beri balasan dengan Jahannam, demikian Kami memberikan pembalasan kepada orang-orang zalim.

arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Awalam yaral lazeena kafarooo annas samaawaati wal arda kaanataa ratqan faftaqnaahumaa wa ja'alnaa minal maaa'i kulla shai'in haiyin afalaa yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
translations.en.pickthall: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?
translations.en.yusufali: Do not the Unbelievers see that the heavens and the earth were joined together (as one unit of creation), before we clove them asunder? We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apakah orang-orang yang kafir tidak mengetahui bahwasanya langit dan bumi itu keduanya dahulu adalah suatu yang padu, kemudian Kami pisahkan antara keduanya. Dan dari air Kami jadikan segala sesuatu yang hidup. Maka mengapakah mereka tiada juga beriman?

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa fil ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bihim wa ja'alnaa feehaa fijaajan subulal la'allahum yahtadoon

translations.en.sahih: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
translations.en.pickthall: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way.
translations.en.yusufali: And We have set on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein broad highways (between mountains) for them to pass through: that they may receive Guidance.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan telah Kami jadikan di bumi ini gunung-gunung yang kokoh supaya bumi itu (tidak) goncang bersama mereka dan telah Kami jadikan (pula) di bumi itu jalan-jalan yang luas, agar mereka mendapat petunjuk.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
transliteration: Wa ja'alnas samaaa'a saqfam mahfoozanw wa hum 'an Aayaatihaa mu'ridoon

translations.en.sahih: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
translations.en.pickthall: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents.
translations.en.yusufali: And We have made the heavens as a canopy well guarded: yet do they turn away from the Signs which these things (point to)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami menjadikan langit itu sebagai atap yang terpelihara, sedang mereka berpaling dari segala tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) yang terdapat padanya.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee khalaqal laila wannahaara washshamsa wal qamara kullun fee falakiny yashbahoon

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
translations.en.pickthall: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.
translations.en.yusufali: It is He Who created the Night and the Day, and the sun and the moon: all (the celestial bodies) swim along, each in its rounded course.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Dialah yang telah menciptakan malam dan siang, matahari dan bulan. Masing-masing dari keduanya itu beredar di dalam garis edarnya.

arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ
transliteration: Wa maa ja'alnaa libasharim min qablikal khuld; afaimmitta fahumul khaalidoon

translations.en.sahih: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
translations.en.pickthall: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal!
translations.en.yusufali: We granted not to any man before thee permanent life (here): if then thou shouldst die, would they live permanently?
translations.id.indonesian: Kami tidak menjadikan hidup abadi bagi seorang manusiapun sebelum kamu (Muhammad); maka jikalau kamu mati, apakah mereka akan kekal?

arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
transliteration: Kullu nafsin zaaa'iqatul mawt; wa nablookum bishsharri walkhairi fitnatanw wa ilainaa turja'oon

translations.en.sahih: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
translations.en.pickthall: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.
translations.en.yusufali: Every soul shall have a taste of death: and We test you by evil and by good by way of trial. to Us must ye return.
translations.id.indonesian: Tiap-tiap yang berjiwa akan merasakan mati. Kami akan menguji kamu dengan keburukan dan kebaikan sebagai cobaan (yang sebenar-benarnya). Dan hanya kepada Kamilah kamu dikembalikan.

arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa ra aakal lazeena kafarooo iny-yattakhizoonaka illa huzuwaa; ahaazal lazee yazkuru aalihatakum wa hum bi zikrir Rahmaani hum kaafiroon

translations.en.sahih: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
translations.en.pickthall: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.
translations.en.yusufali: When the Unbelievers see thee, they treat thee not except with ridicule. "Is this," (they say), "the one who talks of your gods?" and they blaspheme at the mention of (Allah) Most Gracious!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apahila orang-orang kafir itu melihat kamu, mereka hanya membuat kamu menjadi olok-olok. (Mereka mengatakan): "Apakah ini orang yang mencela tuhan-tuhan-mu?", padahal mereka adaIah orang-orang yang ingkar mengingat Allah Yang Maha Pemurah.

arabic: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
transliteration: Khuliqal insaanu min 'ajal; sa ureekum Aayaatee falaa tasta'jiloon

translations.en.sahih: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.
translations.en.pickthall: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.
translations.en.yusufali: Man is a creature of haste: soon (enough) will I show you My Signs; then ye will not ask Me to hasten them!
translations.id.indonesian: Manusia telah dijadikan (bertabiat) tergesa-gesa. Kelak akan Aku perIihatkan kepadamu tanda-tanda azab-Ku. Maka janganlah kamu minta kepada-Ku mendatangkannya dengan segera.

arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
transliteration: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
translations.en.yusufali: They say: "When will this promise come to pass, if ye are telling the truth?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Kapankah janji itu akan datang, jika kamu sekaIian adalah orang-orang yang benar?"

arabic: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
transliteration: Law ya'lamul lazeena kafaroo heena laa yakuffoona 'anw wujoohihimun Naara wa laa 'an zuhoorihim wa laa hum yunsaroon

translations.en.sahih: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
translations.en.pickthall: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped!
translations.en.yusufali: If only the Unbelievers knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the fire from their faces, nor yet from their backs, and (when) no help can reach them!
translations.id.indonesian: Andaikata orang-orang kafir itu mengetahui, waktu (di mana) mereka itu tidak mampu mengelakkan api neraka dari muka mereka dan (tidak pula) dari punggung mereka, sedang mereka (tidak pula) mendapat pertolongan, (tentulah mereka tiada meminta disegerakan).

arabic: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
transliteration: Bal taateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falaa yastatee'oona raddahaa wa laa hum yunzaroon

translations.en.sahih: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, it may come to them all of a sudden and confound them: no power will they have then to avert it, nor will they (then) get respite.
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarnya (azab) itu akan datang kepada mereka dengan sekonyong-konyong lalu membuat mereka menjadi panik, maka mereka tidak sanggup menolaknya dan tidak (pula) mereka diberi tangguh.

arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
transliteration: Wa laqadis tuhzi'a bi-Rusulim min qablika fahaaqa billazeena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

translations.en.sahih: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
translations.en.pickthall: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.
translations.en.yusufali: Mocked were (many) messenger before thee; But their scoffers were hemmed in by the thing that they mocked.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sungguh telah diperolok-olokkan beberapa orang rasul sebelum kamu maka turunlah kepada orang yang mencemoohkan rasul-rasul itu azab yang selalu mereka perolok-olokkan.

arabic: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
transliteration: Qul mai yakla 'ukum billaili wannahaari minar Rahmaan; bal hum 'an zikri Rabbihim mu'ridoon

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
translations.en.pickthall: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord.
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Siapakah yang dapat memelihara kamu di waktu malam dan siang hari dari (azab Allah) Yang Maha Pemurah?" Sebenarnya mereka adalah orang-orang yang berpaling dari mengingati Tuhan mereka.

arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
transliteration: Am lahum aalihatun tamna'ulum min dooninaa; laa yastatee'oona nasra anfusihim wa laa hum minnna yus-haboon

translations.en.sahih: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
translations.en.pickthall: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.
translations.en.yusufali: Or have they gods that can guard them from Us? They have no power to aid themselves, nor can they be defended from Us.
translations.id.indonesian: Atau adakah mereka mempunyai tuhan-tuhan yang dapat memelihara mereka dari (azab) Kami. Tuhan-tuhan itu tidak sanggup menolong diri mereka sendiri dan tidak (pula) mereka dilindungi dari (azab) Kami itu?

arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
transliteration: Bal matta'naa haaa'ulaaa'i wa aabaaa'ahum hattaa taala 'alaihimul 'umur; afalaa yarawna anna naatil arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa; afahumul ghaaliboon

translations.en.sahih: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, We gave the good things of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them; See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will win?
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarnya Kami telah memberi mereka dan bapak-bapak mereka kenikmatan (hidup di dunia) hingga panjanglah umur mereka. Maka apakah mereka tidak melihat bahwasanya Kami mendatangi negeri (orang kafir), lalu Kami kurangi luasnya dari segala penjurunya. Maka apakah mereka yang menang?

arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
transliteration: Qul innamaaa unzirukum bilwahyi; wa laa yasma'us summud du'aaa'a izaa maa yunzaroon

translations.en.sahih: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
translations.en.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.
translations.en.yusufali: Say, "I do but warn you according to revelation": But the deaf will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned!
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah (hai Muhammad): "Sesungguhnya aku hanya memberi peringatan kepada kamu sekalian dengan wahyu dan tiadalah orang-orang yang tuli mendengar seruan, apabila mereka diberi peringatan"

arabic: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa la'im massat hum nafhatum min 'azaabi Rabbika la yaqoolunna yaawailanaaa innnaa kunnaa zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
translations.en.pickthall: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.
translations.en.yusufali: If but a breath of the Wrath of thy Lord do touch them, they will then say, "Woe to us! we did wrong indeed!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya, jika mereka ditimpa sedikit saja dari azab Tuhan-mu, pastilah mereka berkata: "Aduhai, celakalah kami, bahwasanya kami adalah orang yang menganiaya diri sendiri".

arabic: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ
transliteration: Wa nada'ul mawaazeenal qista li Yawmil Qiyaamati falaa tuzlamu nafsun shai'aa; wa in kaana misqaala habbatim min khardalin atainaa bihaa; wa kafaa binaa haasibeen

translations.en.sahih: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
translations.en.pickthall: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.
translations.en.yusufali: We shall set up scales of justice for the Day of Judgment, so that not a soul will be dealt with unjustly in the least, and if there be (no more than) the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account): and enough are We to take account.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami akan memasang timbangan yang tepat pada hari kiamat, maka tiadalah dirugikan seseorang barang sedikitpun. Dan jika (amalan itu) hanya seberat biji sawipun pasti Kami mendatangkan (pahala)nya. Dan cukuplah Kami sebagai pembuat perhitungan.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
transliteration: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosa wa haaroonal Furqaana wa diyaa'anw wa zikral lilmuttaqeen

translations.en.sahih: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
translations.en.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,
translations.en.yusufali: In the past We granted to Moses and Aaron the criterion (for judgment), and a Light and a Message for those who would do right,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami berikan kepada Musa dan Harun Kitab Taurat dan penerangan serta pengajaran bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa.

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
transliteration: Allazeena yakhshawna Rabbahum bilghaibi wa hum minas Saa'ati mushfiqoon

translations.en.sahih: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
translations.en.pickthall: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).
translations.en.yusufali: Those who fear their Lord in their most secret thoughts, and who hold the Hour (of Judgment) in awe.
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) orang-orang yang takut akan (azab) Tuhan mereka, sedang mereka tidak melihat-Nya, dan mereka merasa takut akan (tibanya) hari kiamat.

arabic: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa haazaa Zikrum Mubaarakun anzalnaah; afa antum lahoo munkiroon

translations.en.sahih: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
translations.en.pickthall: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?
translations.en.yusufali: And this is a blessed Message which We have sent down: will ye then reject it?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Al Quran ini adalah suatu kitab (peringatan) yang mempunyai berkah yang telah Kami turunkan. Maka mengapakah kamu mengingkarinya?

arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa laqad aatainaaa Ibraaheema rushdahoo min qablu wa kunnaa bihee 'aalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
translations.en.pickthall: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,
translations.en.yusufali: We bestowed aforetime on Abraham his rectitude of conduct, and well were We acquainted with him.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami anugerahkan kepada Ibrahim hidayah kebenaran sebelum (Musa dan Harun), dan adalah Kami mengetahui (keadaan)nya.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ
transliteration: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa haazihit tamaaseelul lateee antum lahee 'aakifoon

translations.en.sahih: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
translations.en.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! he said to his father and his people, "What are these images, to which ye are (so assiduously) devoted?"
translations.id.indonesian: (Ingatlah), ketika Ibrahim berkata kepada bapaknya dan kaumnya: "Patung-patung apakah ini yang kamu tekun beribadat kepadanya?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa lahaa 'aabideen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Kami mendapati bapak-bapak kami menyembahnya".

arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Qaala laqad kuntum antum wa aabaaa'ukum fee dalaalim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.
translations.en.yusufali: He said, "Indeed ye have been in manifest error - ye and your fathers."
translations.id.indonesian: Ibrahim berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu dan bapak-bapakmu berada dalam kesesatan yang nyata".

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ
transliteration: Qaalooo aji'tanaa bil haqqi am anta minal laa'ibeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "Have you brought us the Truth, or are you one of those who jest?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Apakah kamu datang kepada kami dengan sungguh-sungguh ataukah kamu termasuk orang-orang yang bermain-main?"

arabic: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
transliteration: Qaala bar Rabbukum Rabbus samaawaati wal ardil lazee fatarahunna wa ana 'alaa zaalikum minash shaahideen

translations.en.sahih: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.
translations.en.yusufali: He said, "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He Who created them (from nothing): and I am a witness to this (Truth).
translations.id.indonesian: Ibrahim berkata: "Sebenarnya Tuhan kamu ialah Tuhan langit dan bumi yang telah menciptakannya: dan aku termasuk orang-orang yang dapat memberikan bukti atas yang demikian itu".

arabic: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
transliteration: Wa tallaahi la akeedanna asnaamakum ba'da an tuwalloo mudbireen

translations.en.sahih: And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
translations.en.pickthall: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.
translations.en.yusufali: "And by Allah, I have a plan for your idols - after ye go away and turn your backs"..
translations.id.indonesian: Demi Allah, sesungguhnya aku akan melakukan tipu daya terhadap berhala-berhalamu sesudah kamu pergi meninggalkannya.

arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
transliteration: Faja'alahum juzaazan illaa kabeeral lahum la'allahum ilaihi yarji'oon

translations.en.sahih: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
translations.en.pickthall: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.
translations.en.yusufali: So he broke them to pieces, (all) but the biggest of them, that they might turn (and address themselves) to it.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Ibrahim membuat berhala-berhala itu hancur berpotong-potong, kecuali yang terbesar (induk) dari patung-patung yang lain; agar mereka kembali (untuk bertanya) kepadanya.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo man fa'ala haazaa bi aalihatinaaa innahoo laminaz zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? He must indeed be some man of impiety!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Siapakah yang melakukan perbuatan ini terhadap tuhan-tuhan kami, sesungguhnya dia termasuk orang-orang yang zalim".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
transliteration: Qaaloo sami'naa fatany yazkuruhum yuqaalu lahooo Ibraaheem

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "We heard a youth talk of them: He is called Abraham."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Kami dengar ada seorang pemuda yang mencela berhala-berhala ini yang bernama Ibrahim".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
transliteration: Qaaloo faatoo bihee 'alaaa a'yunin naasi la'allahum yash hadoon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "(Kalau demikian) bawalah dia dengan cara yang dapat dilihat orang banyak, agar mereka menyaksikan".

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
transliteration: Qaalooo 'a-anta fa'alta haazaa bi aalihatinaa yaaa Ibraaheem

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "Art thou the one that did this with our gods, O Abraham?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka bertanya: "Apakah kamu, yang melakukan perbuatan ini terhadap tuhan-tuhan kami, hai Ibrahim?"

arabic: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
transliteration: Qaala bal fa'alahoo kabeeruhum haazaa fas'aloohum in kaanoo yantiqoon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Nay, this was done by - this is their biggest one! ask them, if they can speak intelligently!"
translations.id.indonesian: Ibrahim menjawab: "Sebenarnya patung yang besar itulah yang melakukannya, maka tanyakanlah kepada berhala itu, jika mereka dapat berbicara".

arabic: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
transliteration: Faraja'ooo ilaaa anfusihim faqaalooo innakum antumuz zaalimoon

translations.en.sahih: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
translations.en.pickthall: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.
translations.en.yusufali: So they turned to themselves and said, "Surely ye are the ones in the wrong!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka telah kembali kepada kesadaran dan lalu berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu sekalian adalah orang-orang yang menganiaya (diri sendiri)",

arabic: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
transliteration: Summa nukisoo 'alaa ru'oosihim laqad 'alimta maa haaa'ulaaa'i yantiqoon

translations.en.sahih: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
translations.en.pickthall: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.
translations.en.yusufali: Then were they confounded with shame: (they said), "Thou knowest full well that these (idols) do not speak!"
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian kepala mereka jadi tertunduk (lalu berkata): "Sesungguhnya kamu (hai Ibrahim) telah mengetahui bahwa berhala-berhala itu tidak dapat berbicara".

arabic: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
transliteration: Qaala afata'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'ukum shai'anw wa laa yadurrukum

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?
translations.en.yusufali: (Abraham) said, "Do ye then worship, besides Allah, things that can neither be of any good to you nor do you harm?
translations.id.indonesian: Ibrahim berkata: Maka mengapakah kamu menyembah selain Allah sesuatu yang tidak dapat memberi manfaat sedikitpun dan tidak (pula) memberi mudharat kepada kamu?"

arabic: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
transliteration: Uffil lakum wa limaa ta'budoona min doonil laah; afalaa ta'qiloon

translations.en.sahih: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason?"
translations.en.pickthall: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?
translations.en.yusufali: "Fie upon you, and upon the things that ye worship besides Allah! Have ye no sense?"..
translations.id.indonesian: Ah (celakalah) kamu dan apa yang kamu sembah selain Allah. Maka apakah kamu tidak memahami?

arabic: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo harriqooho wansurooo aalihatakum in kuntum faa'ileen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
translations.en.pickthall: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "Burn him and protect your gods, If ye do (anything at all)!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Bakarlah dia dan bantulah tuhan-tuhan kamu, jika kamu benar-benar hendak bertindak".

arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
transliteration: Qulnaa yaa naaru koonee bardanw wa salaaman 'alaaa Ibraaheem

translations.en.sahih: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
translations.en.pickthall: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,
translations.en.yusufali: We said, "O Fire! be thou cool, and (a means of) safety for Abraham!"
translations.id.indonesian: Kami berfirman: "Hai api menjadi dinginlah, dan menjadi keselamatanlah bagi Ibrahim",

arabic: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
transliteration: Wa araadoo bihee kaidan faja'alnaahumul akhsareen

translations.en.sahih: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.
translations.en.pickthall: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.
translations.en.yusufali: Then they sought a stratagem against him: but We made them the ones that lost most!
translations.id.indonesian: mereka hendak berbuat makar terhadap Ibrahim, maka Kami menjadikan mereka itu orang-orang yang paling merugi.

arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wa najjainaahu wa Lootan ilal ardil latee baaraknaa feehaa lil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.
translations.en.yusufali: But We delivered him and (his nephew) Lut (and directed them) to the land which We have blessed for the nations.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami seIamatkan Ibrahim dan Luth ke sebuah negeri yang Kami telah memberkahinya untuk sekalian manusia.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Wa wahabnaa lahooo Ishaaq; wa Ya'qooba naafilah; wa kullan ja'alnaa saaliheen

translations.en.sahih: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.
translations.en.yusufali: And We bestowed on him Isaac and, as an additional gift, (a grandson), Jacob, and We made righteous men of every one (of them).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah memberikan kepada-nya (Ibrahim) lshak dan Ya'qub, sebagai suatu anugerah (daripada Kami). Dan masing-masingnya Kami jadikan orang-orang yang saleh

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
transliteration: Wa ja'alnaahum a'immatany yahdoona bi amrinaa wa awhainaaa ilaihim fi'lal khairaati wa iqaamas Salaati wa eetaaa'az Zakaati wa kaanoo lanaa 'aabideen

translations.en.sahih: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.
translations.en.pickthall: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).
translations.en.yusufali: And We made them leaders, guiding (men) by Our Command, and We sent them inspiration to do good deeds, to establish regular prayers, and to practise regular charity; and they constantly served Us (and Us only).
translations.id.indonesian: Kami telah menjadikan mereka itu sebagai pemimpin-pemimpin yang memberi petunjuk dengan perintah Kami dan telah Kami wahyukan kepada, mereka mengerjakan kebajikan, mendirikan sembahyang, menunaikan zakat, dan hanya kepada Kamilah mereka selalu menyembah,

arabic: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ
transliteration: Wa Lootan aatainaahu hukmanw wa 'ilmanw wa najjainaahu minal qaryatil latee kaanat ta'malul khabaaa'is; innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in faasiqeen

translations.en.sahih: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
translations.en.pickthall: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.
translations.en.yusufali: And to Lut, too, We gave Judgment and Knowledge, and We saved him from the town which practised abominations: truly they were a people given to Evil, a rebellious people.
translations.id.indonesian: dan kepada Luth, Kami telah berikan hikmah dan ilmu, dan telah Kami selamatkan dia dari (azab yang telah menimpa penduduk) kota yang mengerjakan perbuatan keji. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah kaum yang jahat lagi fasik,

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Wa adkhalnaahu fee rahmatinaa innahoo minas saalihee

translations.en.sahih: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous.
translations.en.yusufali: And We admitted him to Our Mercy: for he was one of the Righteous.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami masukkan dia ke dalam rahmat Kami; karena sesungguhnya dia termasuk orang-orang yang saleh.

arabic: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Wa noohan iz naadaa min qablu fastajabnaa lahoo fanajjainaahu wa ahlahoo minal karbil 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.
translations.en.pickthall: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.
translations.en.yusufali: (Remember) Noah, when he cried (to Us) aforetime: We listened to his (prayer) and delivered him and his family from great distress.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (ingatlah kisah) Nuh, sebelum itu ketika dia berdoa, dan Kami memperkenankan doanya, lalu Kami selamatkan dia beserta keluarganya dari bencana yang besar.

arabic: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Wa nasarnaahu minal qawmil lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa; innahum kkaanoo qawma saw'in fa-aghraq naahum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
translations.en.pickthall: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.
translations.en.yusufali: We helped him against people who rejected Our Signs: truly they were a people given to Evil: so We drowned them (in the Flood) all together.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah menolongnya dari kaum yang telah mendustakan ayat-ayat Kami. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah kaum yang jahat, maka Kami tenggelamkan mereka semuanya.

arabic: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ
transliteration: Wa Daawooda wa Sulaimaana iz yahkumaani fil harsi iz nafashat feehi ghanamul qawmi wa kunnaa lihukmihim shaahideen

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
translations.en.pickthall: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.
translations.en.yusufali: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the matter of the field into which the sheep of certain people had strayed by night: We did witness their judgment.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (ingatlah kisah) Daud dan Sulaiman, di waktu keduanya memberikan keputusan mengenai tanaman, karena tanaman itu dirusak oleh kambing-kambing kepunyaan kaumnya. Dan adalah Kami menyaksikan keputusan yang diberikan oleh mereka itu,

arabic: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
transliteration: Fafahhamnaahaa sulaimaan; wa kullan aatainaa hukmanw wa'ilmanw wa sakh kharnaa ma'a Daawoodal jibaala yusabbihna wattayr; wa kunnaa faa'ileen

translations.en.sahih: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
translations.en.pickthall: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof).
translations.en.yusufali: To Solomon We inspired the (right) understanding of the matter: to each (of them) We gave Judgment and Knowledge; it was Our power that made the hills and the birds celebrate Our praises, with David: it was We Who did (all these things).
translations.id.indonesian: maka Kami telah memberikan pengertian kepada Sulaiman tentang hukum (yang lebih tepat); dan kepada masing-masing mereka telah Kami berikan hikmah dan ilmu dan telah Kami tundukkan gunung-gunung dan burung-burung, semua bertasbih bersama Daud. Dan kamilah yang melakukannya.

arabic: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa 'allamanaahu san'ata laboosil lakum lituhsinakum mim baasikum fahal antum shaakiroon

translations.en.sahih: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
translations.en.pickthall: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful?
translations.en.yusufali: It was We Who taught him the making of coats of mail for your benefit, to guard you from each other's violence: will ye then be grateful?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan telah Kami ajarkan kepada Daud membuat baju besi untuk kamu, guna memelihara kamu dalam peperanganmu; Maka hendaklah kamu bersyukur (kepada Allah).

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa li Sulaimaanar reeha 'aasifatan tajree bi amriheee ilal ardil latee baaraknaa feehaa; wa kunnaa bikulli shai'in 'aalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
translations.en.pickthall: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware.
translations.en.yusufali: (It was Our power that made) the violent (unruly) wind flow (tamely) for Solomon, to his order, to the land which We had blessed: for We do know all things.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (telah Kami tundukkan) untuk Sulaiman angin yang sangat kencang tiupannya yang berhembus dengan perintahnya ke negeri yang kami telah memberkatinya. Dan adalah Kami Maha Mengetahui segala sesuatu.

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
transliteration: Wa minash Shayaateeni mai yaghoosoona lahoo wa ya'maloona 'amalan doona zaalika wa kunna lahum baafizeen

translations.en.sahih: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
translations.en.pickthall: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them.
translations.en.yusufali: And of the evil ones, were some who dived for him, and did other work besides; and it was We Who guarded them.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah tundukkan (pula kepada Sulaiman) segolongan syaitan-syaitan yang menyelam (ke dalam laut) untuknya dan mengerjakan pekerjaan selain daripada itu, dan adalah Kami memelihara mereka itu,

arabic: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa Ayyooba iz naadaa Rabbahooo annee massaniyad durru wa Anta arhamur raahimeen

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."
translations.en.pickthall: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
translations.en.yusufali: And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, "Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."
translations.id.indonesian: dan (ingatlah kisah) Ayub, ketika ia menyeru Tuhannya: "(Ya Tuhanku), sesungguhnya aku telah ditimpa penyakit dan Engkau adalah Tuhan Yang Maha Penyayang di antara semua penyayang".

arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
transliteration: Fastajabnaa lahoo fakashaf naa maa bihee min durrinw wa aatainaahu ahlahoo wa mislahum ma'ahum rahmatam min 'indinaa wa zikraa lil'aabideen

translations.en.sahih: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;
translations.en.yusufali: So We listened to him: We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his people to him, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who serve Us.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kamipun memperkenankan seruannya itu, lalu Kami lenyapkan penyakit yang ada padanya dan Kami kembalikan keluarganya kepadanya, dan Kami lipat gandakan bilangan mereka, sebagai suatu rahmat dari sisi Kami dan untuk menjadi peringatan bagi semua yang menyembah Allah.

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
transliteration: Wa Ismaa'eela wa Idreesa wa Zal Kifli kullum minas saabireen

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
translations.en.pickthall: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast.
translations.en.yusufali: And (remember) Isma'il, Idris, and Zul-kifl, all (men) of constancy and patience;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (ingatlah kisah) Ismail, Idris dan Dzulkifli. Semua mereka termasuk orang-orang yang sabar.

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Wa adkhalnaahum fee rahmatinaa innahum minas saaliheen

translations.en.sahih: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous.
translations.en.yusufali: We admitted them to Our mercy: for they were of the righteous ones.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami telah memasukkan mereka kedalam rahmat Kami. Sesungguhnya mereka termasuk orang-orang yang saleh.

arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa Zan Nooni iz zahaba mughaadiban fazaanna al lan naqdira 'alaihi fanaanna al lan naqdira 'alaihi fanaadaa fiz zulumaati al laaa ilaaha illaaa Anta Subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
translations.en.pickthall: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.
translations.en.yusufali: And remember Zun-nun, when he departed in wrath: He imagined that We had no power over him! But he cried through the deptHs of darkness, "There is no god but thou: glory to thee: I was indeed wrong!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (ingatlah kisah) Dzun Nun (Yunus), ketika ia pergi dalam keadaan marah, lalu ia menyangka bahwa Kami tidak akan mempersempitnya (menyulitkannya), maka ia menyeru dalam keadaan yang sangat gelap: "Bahwa tidak ada Tuhan selain Engkau. Maha Suci Engkau, sesungguhnya aku adalah termasuk orang-orang yang zalim".

arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Fastajabnaa lahoo wa najjainaahu minal ghamm; wa kazaalika nunjil mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
translations.en.pickthall: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.
translations.en.yusufali: So We listened to him: and delivered him from distress: and thus do We deliver those who have faith.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami telah memperkenankan doanya dan menyelamatkannya dari pada kedukaan. Dan demikianlah Kami selamatkan orang-orang yang beriman.

arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
transliteration: Wa Zakariyyaaa iz naadaa Rabbahoo Rabbi laa tazarnee fardanw wa Anta khairul waariseen

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."
translations.en.pickthall: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors.
translations.en.yusufali: And (remember) Zakariya, when he cried to his Lord: "O my Lord! leave me not without offspring, though thou art the best of inheritors."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (ingatlah kisah) Zakaria, tatkala ia menyeru Tuhannya: "Ya Tuhanku janganlah Engkau membiarkan aku hidup seorang diri dan Engkaulah Waris Yang Paling Baik.

arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ
transliteration: Fastajabnaa lahoo wa wahabnaa lahoo Yahyaa Wa aslahnaa lahoo zawjah; innahum kaanoo yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa yad'oonanaa raghabanw wa rahabaa; wa kaanoo lanaa khaashi'een

translations.en.sahih: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us.
translations.en.yusufali: So We listened to him: and We granted him Yahya: We cured his wife's (Barrenness) for him. These (three) were ever quick in emulation in good works; they used to call on Us with love and reverence, and humble themselves before Us.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami memperkenankan doanya, dan Kami anugerahkan kepada nya Yahya dan Kami jadikan isterinya dapat mengandung. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah orang-orang yang selalu bersegera dalam (mengerjakan) perbuatan-perbuatan yang baik dan mereka berdoa kepada Kami dengan harap dan cemas. Dan mereka adalah orang-orang yang khusyu' kepada Kami.

arabic: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wallateee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa mir roohinaa wa ja'alnaahaa wabnahaaa Aayatal lil'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.
translations.en.yusufali: And (remember) her who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and We made her and her son a sign for all peoples.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (ingatlah kisah) Maryam yang telah memelihara kehormatannya, lalu Kami tiupkan ke dalam (tubuh)nya ruh dari Kami dan Kami jadikan dia dan anaknya tanda (kekuasaan Allah) yang besar bagi semesta alam.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
transliteration: Inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw wa Ana Rabbukum fa'budoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, this brotherhood of yours is a single brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore serve Me (and no other).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya (agama Tauhid) ini adalah agama kamu semua; agama yang satu dan Aku adalah Tuhanmu, maka sembahlah Aku.

arabic: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
transliteration: Wa taqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum kullun ilainaaa raaji'oon

translations.en.sahih: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.
translations.en.pickthall: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us.
translations.en.yusufali: But (later generations) cut off their affair (of unity), one from another: (yet) will they all return to Us.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka telah memotong-motong urusan (agama) mereka di antara mereka. Kepada Kamilah masing-masing golongan itu akan kembali.

arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَـٰتِبُونَ
transliteration: Famai ya'mal minas saalihaati wa huwa mu'minun falaa kufraana lisa'yihee wa innaa lahoo kaatiboon

translations.en.sahih: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders.
translations.en.pickthall: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him.
translations.en.yusufali: Whoever works any act of righteousness and has faith,- His endeavour will not be rejected: We shall record it in his favour.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka barang siapa yang mengerjakan amal saleh, sedang ia beriman, maka tidak ada pengingkaran terhadap amalannya itu dan sesungguhnya Kami menuliskan amalannya itu untuknya.

arabic: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
transliteration: Wa haraamun 'alaa qaryatin ahlaknaahaaa annahum laa yarji'oon

translations.en.sahih: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
translations.en.pickthall: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return.
translations.en.yusufali: But there is a ban on any population which We have destroyed: that they shall not return,
translations.id.indonesian: Sungguh tidak mungkin atas (penduduk) suatu negeri yang telah Kami binasakan, bahwa mereka tidak akan kembali (kepada Kami).

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
transliteration: Hattaaa izaa futihat Yaajooju wa Maajooju wa hum min kulli hadabiny yansiloon

translations.en.sahih: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
translations.en.pickthall: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound,
