translations.en.yusufali: Until the Gog and Magog (people) are let through (their barrier), and they swiftly swarm from every hill.
translations.id.indonesian: Hingga apabila dibukakan (tembok) Ya'juj dan Ma'juj, dan mereka turun dengan cepat dari seluruh tempat yang tinggi.

arabic: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Waqtarabal wa'dul haqqu fa-izaa hiya shaakhisatun absaarul lazeena kafaroo yaawailanaa qad kunna fee ghaflatim min haaza bal kunnaa zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
translations.en.pickthall: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers!
translations.en.yusufali: Then will the true promise draw nigh (of fulfilment): then behold! the eyes of the Unbelievers will fixedly stare in horror: "Ah! Woe to us! we were indeed heedless of this; nay, we truly did wrong!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan telah dekatlah kedatangan janji yang benar (hari berbangkit), maka tiba-tiba terbelalaklah mata orang-orang yang kafir. (Mereka berkata): "Aduhai, celakalah kami, sesungguhnya kami adalah dalam kelalaian tentang ini, bahkan kami adalah orang-orang yang zalim".

arabic: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
transliteration: Innakum wa maa ta'budoona min doonil laahi hasabu Jahannama antum lahaa waaridoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily ye, (unbelievers), and the (false) gods that ye worship besides Allah, are (but) fuel for Hell! to it will ye (surely) come!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kamu dan apa yang kamu sembah selain Allah, adalah umpan Jahannam, kamu pasti masuk ke dalamnya.

arabic: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
transliteration: Law kaana haaa'ulaaa'i aalihatam maa waradoohaa wa kullun feehaa khaalidoon

translations.en.sahih: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
translations.en.pickthall: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein.
translations.en.yusufali: If these had been gods, they would not have got there! but each one will abide therein.
translations.id.indonesian: Andaikata berhala-berhala itu Tuhan, tentulah mereka tidak masuk neraka. Dan semuanya akan kekal di dalamnya.

arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
transliteration: Lahum feehaa zafeerunw wa hum feehaa laa yasma'oon

translations.en.sahih: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
translations.en.pickthall: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not.
translations.en.yusufali: There, sobbing will be their lot, nor will they there hear (aught else).
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka merintih di dalam api dan mereka di dalamnya tidak bisa mendengar.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
transliteration: Innal lazeena sabaqat lahum minnal husnaaa ulaaa'ika 'anhaa mub'adoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence.
translations.en.yusufali: Those for whom the good (record) from Us has gone before, will be removed far therefrom.
translations.id.indonesian: Bahwasanya orang-orang yang telah ada untuk mereka ketetapan yang baik dari Kami, mereka itu dijauhkan dari neraka,

arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
transliteration: Laa yasma'oona hasee sahaa wa hum fee mash tahat anfusuhum khaalidoon

translations.en.sahih: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
translations.en.pickthall: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire.
translations.en.yusufali: Not the slightest sound will they hear of Hell: what their souls desired, in that will they dwell.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka tidak mendengar sedikitpun suara api neraka, dan mereka kekal dalam menikmati apa yang diingini oleh mereka.

arabic: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Laa yahzunuhumul faza'ul akbaru wa tatalaq qaahumul malaaa'ikatu haazaa Yawmukumul lazee kuntum too'adoon

translations.en.sahih: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
translations.en.pickthall: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised;
translations.en.yusufali: The Great Terror will bring them no grief: but the angels will meet them (with mutual greetings): "This is your Day,- (the Day) that ye were promised."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak disusahkan oleh kedahsyatan yang besar (pada hari kiamat), dan mereka disambut oleh para malaikat. (Malaikat berkata): "Inilah harimu yang telah dijanjikan kepadamu".

arabic: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
transliteration: Yawma natwis samaaa'a kataiyis sijilli lilkutub; kamaa badaanaa awwala khalqin nu'eeduh; wa'dan 'alainaa; innaa kunna faa'ileen

translations.en.sahih: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
translations.en.pickthall: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.
translations.en.yusufali: The Day that We roll up the heavens like a scroll rolled up for books (completed),- even as We produced the first creation, so shall We produce a new one: a promise We have undertaken: truly shall We fulfil it.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) pada hari Kami gulung langit sebagai menggulung lembaran-lembaran kertas. Sebagaimana Kami telah memulai panciptaan pertama begitulah Kami akan mengulanginya. Itulah suatu janji yang pasti Kami tepati; sesungguhnya Kamilah yang akan melaksanakannya.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ
transliteration: Wa laqad katabnaa fiz Zaboori mim ba'diz zikri annal arda yarisuhaa 'ibaadi yas saalihoon

translations.en.sahih: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
translations.en.pickthall: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth:
translations.en.yusufali: Before this We wrote in the Psalms, after the Message (given to Moses): My servants the righteous, shall inherit the earth."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sungguh telah Kami tulis didalam Zabur sesudah (Kami tulis dalam) Lauh Mahfuzh, bahwasanya bumi ini dipusakai hamba-hamba-Ku yang saleh.

arabic: إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ
transliteration: Inna fee haaza labalaa ghal liqawmin 'aabideen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily in this (Qur'an) is a Message for people who would (truly) worship Allah.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya (apa yang disebutkan) dalam (surat) ini, benar-benar menjadi peringatan bagi kaum yang menyembah (Allah).

arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wa maaa arsalnaaka illaa rahmatal lil'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples.
translations.en.yusufali: We sent thee not, but as a Mercy for all creatures.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tiadalah Kami mengutus kamu, melainkan untuk (menjadi) rahmat bagi semesta alam.

arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
transliteration: Qul innamaa yoohaa ilaiya annamaaa ilaahukum illaahunw Waahid, fahal antum muslimoon

translations.en.sahih: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
translations.en.pickthall: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)?
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "What has come to me by inspiration is that your Allah is One Allah: will ye therefore bow to His Will (in Islam)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya yang diwahyukan kepadaku adalah: "Bahwasanya Tuhanmu adalah Tuhan Yang Esa. maka hendaklah kamu berserah diri (kepada-Nya)".

arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Fa in tawallaw faqul aazantukum 'alaa sawaaa'; wa in adreee aqareebun am ba'eedum maa too'adoon

translations.en.sahih: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
translations.en.pickthall: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised.
translations.en.yusufali: But if they turn back, Say: "I have proclaimed the Message to you all alike and in truth; but I know not whether that which ye are promised is near or far.
translations.id.indonesian: Jika mereka berpaling, maka katakanlah: "Aku telah menyampaikan kepada kamu sekalian (ajaran) yang sama (antara kita) dan aku tidak mengetahui apakah yang diancamkan kepadamu itu sudah dekat atau masih jauh?".

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
transliteration: Innahoo ya'lamul jahra minal qawli wa ya'lamu maa taktumoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal.
translations.en.yusufali: "It is He Who knows what is open in speech and what ye hide (in your hearts).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Dia mengetahui perkataan (yang kamu ucapkan) dengan terang-terangan dan Dia mengetahui apa yang kamu rahasiakan.

arabic: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
transliteration: Wa in adree la'allahoo fitnatul lakum wa mataa'un ilaaheen

translations.en.sahih: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
translations.en.pickthall: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while.
translations.en.yusufali: "I know not but that it may be a trial for you, and a grant of (worldly) livelihood (to you) for a time."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku tiada mengetahui, boleh jadi hal itu cobaan bagi kamu dan kesenangan sampai kepada suatu waktu.

arabic: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbih kum bil haqq; wa Rabbunar Rahmaa nul musta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifoon

translations.en.sahih: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
translations.en.pickthall: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "O my Lord! judge Thou in truth!" "Our Lord Most Gracious is the One Whose assistance should be sought against the blasphemies ye utter!"
translations.id.indonesian: (Muhammad) berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, berilah keputusan dengan adil. Dan Tuhan kami ialah Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah lagi Yang dimohonkan pertolongan-Nya terhadap apa yang kamu katakan".
